import zipfile, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')

# sheet name(s)
wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
sheets = [(s.get('name'), s.get('sheetId'), s.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id'))
          for s in wb.find('m:sheets', NS)]
print('Sheets:', sheets)

# map rId -> target file
rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
rid_map = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels}

# shared strings if any
ss = []
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in root.findall('m:si', NS):
        ss.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')))

for name, sid, rid in sheets:
    target = rid_map[rid].lstrip('/')
    if not target.startswith('xl/'):
        target = 'xl/' + target
    print(f'--- Sheet: {name} -> {target} ---')
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
    rows = []
    for row in root.find('m:sheetData', NS).findall('m:row', NS):
        cells = {}
        for c in row.findall('m:c', NS):
            ref = c.get('r')
            t = c.get('t')
            v = c.find('m:v', NS)
            isel = c.find('m:is', NS)
            if isel is not None:
                val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in isel.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
            elif v is not None and v.text is not None:
                val = v.text
                if t == 's':
                    val = ss[int(val)]
            else:
                val = None
            cells[ref] = val
        rows.append(cells)
    # print in grid order
    col_letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
    max_col = 0
    for r in rows:
        for ref in r:
            letters = re.match(r'[A-Z]+', ref).group()
            n = 0
            for ch in letters:
                n = n*26 + (ord(ch)-64)
            max_col = max(max_col, n)
    for r in rows:
        rn = int(re.match(r'(\d+)', next(iter(r))).group(1)) if r else None
        if rn is None: continue
        out = []
        for ci in range(1, max_col+1):
            ref = ''
            x = ci
            while x:
                x, rem = divmod(x-1, 26)
                ref = chr(65+rem) + ref
            out.append(str(r.get(ref+str(rn), '')))
        print(f'R{rn}: ' + ' | '.join(out))
EOF

import zipfile, shutil

src = 'budget.xlsx'
xml = zipfile.ZipFile(src).read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')

# Computed values from data: Income 5000+800+250+100=6150; Expenses = 4200; Balance = 6150-4200=1950
reps = [
    ('<c r="B8" s="3"><f>SUM(B4:B7)</f><v></v></c>',
     '<c r="B8" s="3"><f>SUM(B4:B7)</f><v>6150</v></c>'),
    ('<c r="C23" s="3"><f>SUM(C11:C22)</f><v></v></c>',
     '<c r="C23" s="3"><f>SUM(C11:C22)</f><v>4200</v></c>'),
    ('<c r="B25" s="6"><f>B8-C22</f><v></v></c>',   # bug: C22=Retirement(400), should be C23=Total Expenses
     '<c r="B25" s="6"><f>B8-C23</f><v>1950</v></c>'),
]
for old, new in reps:
    assert old in xml, f'pattern not found: {old}'
    xml = xml.replace(old, new)

shutil.copy(src, src + '.bak')
zin = zipfile.ZipFile(src)
with zipfile.ZipFile(src, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        data = zin.read(item.filename)
        if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            data = xml.encode('utf-8')
        zout.writestr(item, data)
zin.close()
print('budget.xlsx updated OK')
EOF
